word: It was awful-tasting medicine, but I guess the patient needed it.
meaning: 那是一帖難以下嚥的苦藥，但我想病人需要它。
example: The painful experience of being fired was like bitter medicine that he needed to heal and grow.
hint:
中文解釋：用生動的比喻——被解雇像苦藥，雖然難受，卻是必要的療癒過程。
1) awful-tasting (adj.): 味道很糟的；syn: bitter; ant: pleasant
2) medicine (n.): 藥（此處比喻困難的經歷）；syn: remedy; ant: (n/a)
pronunciation: Rueful: it was AWE-ful-TAS-ting MED-i-cine | but I GUESS | the PA-tient NEED-ed it.

word: Sometimes life's gonna hit you in the head with a brick.
meaning: 有時候，人生會用一塊磚頭砸你的頭。
example: Life will sometimes deliver a sudden and painful blow that knocks you down.
hint:
中文解釋：生動的口語比喻，形容人生中突如其來、令人措手不及的打擊。
1) hit you in the head (phr.): 打在頭上（比喻突然的打擊）；syn: knock you down; ant: lift you up
2) brick (n.): 磚頭（比喻沉重的打擊）；syn: blow; ant: feather
pronunciation: Vivid: Some-times LIFE'S gon-na HIT you | in the HEAD | with a BRICK. (punchy)

example: No matter what happens, keep believing in yourself and your path.
hint:
中文解釋：三個字的核心叮嚀——在生命最低谷時，信念是唯一的救生索。
1) lose faith (phr.): 失去信念；syn: give up; ant: keep believing
2) faith (n.): 信念、信仰；syn: belief; ant: doubt
pronunciation: Firm + warm: Don't LOSE faith. (slow, direct, sincere)

word: I'm convinced that the only thing that kept me going was that I loved what I did.
meaning: 我確信，讓我能堅持下去的唯一理由，就是我熱愛我所做的事。
example: He believes that his deep love for his work was what allowed him to keep moving forward.
hint:
中文解釋：整個「Love and Loss」故事的核心結論——愛是一切堅持的根源。
1) convinced (adj.): 確信的；syn: certain; ant: unsure
2) kept me going (phr.): 讓我能繼續下去；syn: sustained me; ant: made me quit
pronunciation: Emphatic: I'm con-VINCED | the ON-ly THING | that KEPT me GO-ing | was that I LOVED what I DID.

word: You've got to find what you love—and that is as true for work as it is for your lovers.
meaning: 你必須找到自己熱愛的事——對工作如此，對愛人也一樣。
example: Just as you must love your partner deeply, you must also truly love your work.
hint:
中文解釋：核心建議——把對愛情的標準用在事業上，你對工作的熱愛要跟對伴侶的愛一樣真摯。
1) you've got to (phr.): 你必須；syn: you must; ant: you don't have to
2) as true for (phr.): 對…同樣適用；syn: equally applies to; ant: different for
pronunciation: Heart: You've GOT to FIND | what you LOVE | as TRUE for WORK | as for your LOV-ers.

word: Your work is going to fill a large part of your life, and the only way to be truly satisfied is to do what you believe is great work.
meaning: 你的工作將會佔據你人生的大部分時間，而唯一能讓你真正滿足的方式，就是去做你認為偉大的事。
example: Since work takes up so much of life, the only path to real satisfaction is doing work that feels meaningful.
hint:
中文解釋：正視工作在人生中的份量，並點明「真正滿足」的條件——不是薪水，而是意義感。
1) fill a large part (phr.): 佔據很大一部分；syn: take up much of; ant: play a small role
2) truly satisfied (phr.): 真正滿足；syn: genuinely fulfilled; ant: merely content
pronunciation: Meaningful: your WORK | will FILL a LARGE part | the ON-ly WAY | to be TRUL-y SAT-is-fied.

word: And the only way to do great work is to love what you do.
meaning: 而做出偉大作品的唯一方式，就是熱愛你所做的事。
example: Great work only comes from people who genuinely love what they are doing.
hint:
中文解釋：簡潔有力的結論——偉大作品的根源是熱愛，沒有捷徑。
1) great work (n.): 偉大的作品；syn: excellent work; ant: mediocre work
2) love what you do (phr.): 熱愛你所做的事；syn: be passionate about your work; ant: tolerate your job
pronunciation: Core truth: the ON-ly WAY | to DO great WORK | is to LOVE | what you DO.

word: If you haven't found it yet, keep looking—and don't settle.
meaning: 如果你還沒找到，繼續找——不要將就。
example: He urges everyone to keep searching for their true passion and not accept anything less.
hint:
中文解釋：最直接的行動呼籲——找到所愛之前，絕不停止尋找，絕不妥協。
1) keep looking (phr.): 持續尋找；syn: never stop searching; ant: give up
2) don't settle (phr.): 不要將就、不要妥協；syn: don't compromise; ant: accept less
pronunciation: Urge: if you HAVE-n't FOUND it YET | KEEP LOOK-ing | and DON'T SET-tle.
